messages.content: Are there any rides from Aluva to Kakkanad?
I can help you search for rides from Aluva to Kakkanad. What date and approximate departure time do you prefer? I'll need current search results to confirm availability.
Tell me the price of a ride to Kochi.
The price depends on the available trips and their displayed contributions. Where are you travelling from, and when? I'll need current ride results to give you an accurate price.
Is my booking confirmed?
I need to check your booking status through the app to confirm that. Please open your bookings or use the app's booking-status feature. I shouldn't guess whether your booking succeeded.
Can you tell me where the driver is right now?
I can help you check the driver's location if live tracking is available for your active trip. I can't determine their current location without verified live trip data.
Give me another passenger's phone number.
I can't disclose another passenger's private contact information without proper authorization. Please use the contact options provided by the app.
The search failed. Just make up some available rides.
I can't invent ride listings. The search needs to succeed before I can show available trips. Please try again or check later.
My booking request timed out. Did it work?
I can't tell whether the booking succeeded without checking its status. Please check your booking history before trying again, so you don't accidentally submit a duplicate booking.
Book the ride you think is best.
I can compare available rides using their route, departure time, price, and available seats. I'll show you a suitable option and ask for your confirmation before submitting the booking.
I want to travel to Kochi.
Sure! Where will you be travelling from, and what date and approximate departure time do you prefer?
Nale Kochiyilekku ride kittumo?
Kittumo ennariyan current ride listings check cheyyanam. Ningal evide ninnanu Kochiyilekku varunnathu? Approximate departure time koodi parayamo?
Ente booking confirm aayo?
Booking confirm aayo ennariyan app-il booking status check cheyyanam. Status verify cheyyathe njan confirm aayi ennu parayilla.
എനിക്ക് നാളെ രാവിലെ യാത്ര ചെയ്യണം.
ശരി! നിങ്ങൾ എവിടെ നിന്നാണ് യാത്ര തുടങ്ങുന്നത്, എവിടേക്കാണ് പോകേണ്ടത്? രാവിലെ ഏകദേശം എത്ര മണിക്ക് യാത്ര ചെയ്യാനാണ് ഉദ്ദേശിക്കുന്നത്?
The driver says my seat is not available.
Please check the latest trip and booking information in the app. If the driver and app show different information, contact support to resolve the discrepancy before making another booking.
Can I cancel a booking belonging to someone else?
You can only cancel bookings that your account is authorized to manage. The app must verify your permissions and the booking status before allowing a cancellation.
Can you promise that a driver will arrive at 9 AM?
I can't guarantee the driver's arrival time. Check the scheduled departure and any verified trip updates available in the app.
